novelty_delta: Thirty-third behaviour. The quantified noun is PLURAL in every row, so the noun cannot be the cue; the quantifier three tokens back decides the auxiliary. That makes it a third distinct route to number: coordination COMPOSES it from two singulars, pp_intervener COPIES it from a plural token, and this OVERRIDES the number a plural token already carries. Overriding is the case none of the existing number behaviours cover, and it is the one where a separate direction is most plausible, since the model must suppress a cue that is present rather than build or propagate one.
